title: Chapter 393 Crocodile Man Vs Stone Man
content:
Chapter 393 Crocodile Man Vs Stone Man

At this time, the number of monsters on the city wall gradually decreased. After all, only a few monsters could reach the city wall in the first place.

However, the monsters under the city wall did not charge without thinking.

I saw several pythons with a length of more than 50 meters. With the help of the power of other monsters, they suddenly strung their heads on the battlements.

The pythons used their heads to firmly support the battlements. The scarlet tongues with a length of more than 5 meters were like flexible whips, whipping the soldiers guarding the battlements.

Cleared a piece.

The pythons' super-long bodies built a bridge, and countless monsters began to rush to the city wall through the bodies of the pythons.

Since there was no resistance from high-level generals, the monsters continued to rush to the top of the city.

Elsewhere, a centipede spirit attached to the city wall formed a ladder. Some smaller monsters stepped on the centipede's feet and climbed up.

Wang Shuo saw this situation and felt like he had fallen into the crocodile man's evil plan.

He alone held back a large number of high-end combat forces on his side.

If it weren't for the Water of Life, the senior generals would not have been qualified to fight him.

Wang Shuo immediately ordered: "Senior generals, go to support other places."

To deal with the crocodile man, Wang Shuo only left Ayub and Gong Zheng to help.

Wang Shuo couldn't help but miss his group of general-level subordinates and teammates in the War General Tower.

In the War General Tower, Wang Shuo could completely defeat ordinary junior generals, but this crocodile man had thick skin and flesh, and Wang Shuo's weapon felt difficult to break his defense, which made Wang Shuo very uncomfortable.

But the battle had to continue, and Wang Shuo couldn't expect Zhao Bangde to provide him with any help now.

Maybe he was in a harder situation than himself at this time.

He was the only one who could deal with the crocodile leader of the monster.

Wang Shuo looked at the crocodile man and felt something was wrong.

Because with the strength of the crocodile man, it was basically easy to deal with ordinary high-level generals.

Even for a top-level general, it is not difficult to kill him, but the fighting power he showed at this time feels a bit mismatched!

That is, his defense is relatively strong.

Could it be that he is stalling for time?

Wang Shuo saw the monsters climbing up from the bottom of the city wall, and he was a little confused. According to this offensive force, delaying for such a little time is not meaningful!

However, seeing the relaxed look on the crocodile man's face, Wang Shuo was always a little uneasy.

No matter what the opponent's plan is, just kill him.

Wang Shuo didn't care, and attacked the crocodile man frantically, fighting to get injured, but also to break the opponent's defense.

Just after Gong Zheng released the "taunt" skill, Wang Shuo stepped forward and asked the crocodile man: "Hey, what's your name?"

The crocodile man opened his mouth and was about to speak.

Wang Shuo seized the opportunity, took the opponent's claw, and then accurately sent a thunder bomb into the opponent's mouth.

The crocodile man reacted quickly and immediately spit out the thunder bomb.

But it was still a beat late, and the thunder bomb exploded at his mouth.

The huge air wave blew all four people away.

Wang Shuo's injury was more serious than that of the crocodile man.

But Wang Shuo smiled, because this time, the crocodile man was finally injured, and at least half of his life was knocked off.

Wang Shuo had the water of life to replenish. In the War General Tower, he harvested a lot of water of life. The Fountain of Life in Wana County also accumulated a lot of water of life in three months.

It can be said that the top leaders of Wana County are not short of such supplies. At the same time, the medical clinic also produced a large number of pills to replenish life. Wana County's supplies are sufficient.
